RRB Group D Results 2026 Declared: Your Gateway to a Railway Career!

The wait is finally over for millions of aspiring candidates! The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially announced the RRB Group D Result 2026 for CEN 08/2024, marking a significant milestone for those who appeared for the Level-1 posts in Indian Railways. With over 32,000 vacancies and more than a crore candidates vying for these positions, securing a place is a monumental achievement.

The Computer Based Test (CBT) for the RRB Group D recruitment drive (CEN 08/2024) was conducted between November 27, 2025, and February 10, 2026. The results, merit lists, and cut-off marks were released on July 1, 2026.

How to Check Your RRB Group D Result 2026

Checking your RRB Group D CBT result is a straightforward process. Follow these detailed steps to quickly find out your qualifying status:

1. Visit Your Regional RRB Website
Navigate to the official website of the Railway Recruitment Board region through which you applied. Each regional RRB (e.g., rrbpryj.gov.in) has published the results separately.
2. Locate the Result Link
On the homepage, look for the "Results" or "Latest Updates" section. You should find a prominent link for "RRB Group D CBT Result 2026 PDF" or "RRB Group D CEN 08/2024 Level 1 Result".
3. Download the Result PDF
Click on the relevant result link. This will open a PDF file containing the roll numbers of all shortlisted candidates for that specific zone.
4. Search for Your Roll Number
Once the PDF is open, use the 'Ctrl + F' (or the search function on your mobile device) and enter your examination roll number to quickly check if you have qualified.

✅ The result is published in zone-wise PDF format.

✅ Qualified candidates' roll numbers are listed in the PDF.

✅ Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Your RRB Group D Scorecard: What It Contains & How to Download

Beyond just checking your qualifying status, the RRB Group D scorecard provides a detailed breakdown of your performance. The scorecard link was activated on July 1, 2026, at 6:00 PM and will remain active until July 16, 2026, at 11:55 PM.

How to Download Your Scorecard:

1. Visit your regional RRB website or the common login portal at rrb.digialm.com.

2. Look for the "RRB Group D Score Card 2026 CEN 08/2024" link.

3. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth (as password).

4. Submit the details to view and download your scorecard.

✅ Candidate's Name and Registration Number

✅ Category and Zone Applied For

✅ Raw Marks and Normalized (Percentile) Marks Obtained

✅ Section-wise and Overall Qualifying Status

✅ Category-wise and Zone-wise Cut-off Marks

Understanding RRB Group D Cut-Off Marks 2026

The Railway Recruitment Board has also released the category-wise and zone-wise cut-off marks alongside the results. These cut-off marks are crucial as they represent the minimum scores required to qualify for the next stage of the selection process.

Several factors influence the cut-off marks each year, including the total number of vacancies, the overall number of candidates who appeared for the exam, the difficulty level of the examination, and the category-wise competition.

The minimum qualifying marks for the CBT are generally 40% for Unreserved (UR) and EWS candidates, and 30% for OBC, SC, and ST candidates. However, it's important to note that the actual zone-wise cut-off marks are typically higher than these baseline percentages.

While specific zone-wise cut-offs should be checked on your respective RRB website, an average analysis from various zones indicates:

  • Most zones have the UR cut-off between 72–79 marks.
  • OBC cut-off is generally 1–2 marks lower than UR.
  • EWS cut-off ranges from 60–75 marks.
  • SC cut-offs are mostly between 66–74 marks.
  • ST remains the lowest, mostly ranging between 58–72 marks.

What's Next? The Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Candidates who have successfully cleared the Computer Based Test (CBT) are now provisionally shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Approximately 63,295 candidates have qualified for this second stage of the recruitment process. The PET is qualifying in nature, meaning candidates must meet the specified physical standards but the marks obtained will not be added to the final merit list.

Details regarding the PET schedule and call letters will be released soon on the official websites of the concerned Railway Recruitment Cells (RRCs). Intimation will also be sent via registered mobile numbers and email IDs.

Here are the PET criteria:

Criteria Male Candidates Female Candidates
Weight Carrying Test Lift and carry 35 kg for 100 metres in 2 minutes without stopping. Lift and carry 20 kg for 100 metres in 2 minutes without stopping.
Running Test Run 1000 metres in 4 minutes 15 seconds in a single attempt. Run 1000 metres in 5 minutes 40 seconds in a single attempt.

Note: Candidates belonging to Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), Ex-Servicemen (ExSM), and Course Completed Act Apprentice (CCAA) categories are exempted from the PET.

Key Dates to Remember

✅ CBT Exam Period: November 27, 2025, to February 10, 2026

✅ Result Declaration Date: July 1, 2026

✅ Scorecard Download Window: July 1, 2026 (6 PM) to July 16, 2026 (11:55 PM)

✅ Next Stage: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) (Dates to be announced)

After the PET, the successful candidates will undergo Document Verification and a Medical Examination. Clearing all stages is essential for final selection and appointment to the Level-1 posts.

Congratulations to all the candidates who have qualified in the RRB Group D CBT 2026! For those moving on to the PET, rigorous preparation is key to success. Stay updated by regularly visiting your regional RRB/RRC websites for the latest announcements regarding the next stages of the recruitment process.
